SPJIMR: a different kind of business school

For over 45 years, SPJIMR has blazed a distinct trail in management education in India, combining a unique mix of social sensitivity, student centricity, teaching excellence, industry connectivity, practice-oriented thought leadership, and community engagement. Through its programmes, research, and centres of practice, SPJIMR aims to foster wise innovation that creates value-based growth to benefit society. Partner with SPJIMR to shape a better world.

Know more

What's new

Global partnership creates new pathway to master’s studies

#AdvancingWiseInnovation

Our pursuit at SPJIMR centres on a very specific type of innovation, which we refer to as ‘wise innovation’. We define ‘wise innovation’ – as purposeful innovation done for the right reasons in the right way. This concept goes beyond mere novelty; it requires a nuanced understanding of innovation’s broader impact and implications.

Know more

Why SPJIMR?

SPJIMR is especially known for its quality of its graduates and the impact they create. Explore how the SPJIMR experience creates exceptional leaders.

In Focus

In focus

In the Financial Times Masters in Management (FT MiM) 2026 ranking, SPJIMR ranked #26 globally and #2 in India. Notably, the institute ranked #1 in India across Careers Service, Alumni Network, Value for Money, and ESG and Net Zero Teaching. It ranked #2 globally for Careers Service and #6 globally for Alumni Network.

Know more

In focus

Join us in Pune to explore SPJIMR’s full-time programmes: PGDM, PGDM (BM), PGPM and GMP. Meet our admissions team, understand the programmes and admissions process, explore career opportunities and get your questions answered. Whether you’re a fresher or an experienced professional, find the programme that fits your experience and career goals.

Register now

In focus

Applications are now open for SPJIMR’s PGDM and PGDM (BM) programmes for the 2027–29 batch. These two-year, full-time, residential, AICTE-approved programmes develop management capabilities through a rigorous, experiential learning environment. The PGDM offers specialisations in Marketing, Finance, Information Management & Analytics, and Operations & Supply Chain, while the PGDM (BM) focuses on General Management.

Apply now

In focus

SPJIMR’s Post Graduate Programme in Family Managed Business (PGPFMB), backed by 29+ years of legacy in family business education, combines the rigour of a leading global business school with the lived realities of family enterprise to prepare the next generation of family business leaders to navigate growth, succession, governance and strategy.

Apply now

In focus

Aspiring for a global career? Applications are now open for SPJIMR’s Global Management Programme (GMP)! Study in Canada, UK, USA, France, Germany or The Netherlands through partnerships with top-ranked B-schools. Earn an international MS/MBA degree and gain the global edge you need to lead in today’s world. The programme admits two cohorts annually — one in January and another in June. Both freshers as well as experienced professionals can apply.

Apply now

In focus

Designed for professionals seeking to grow within corporate CSR or build a career in the development sector, PGPDM at SPJIMR offers the management frameworks, field-based learning, and sectoral insights needed to lead change across NGOs, foundations, social enterprises, and impact-driven organisations.

Apply now

In focus

The Start Your Business (SYB) programme provides participants with the essential knowledge, skills, and mindset to build a sustainable venture. With 20 years of legacy, this hands-on, practical programme is tailored for individuals with an entrepreneurial spirit who are eager to turn their start-up dreams into reality. Admissions ongoing for batch 40 commencing December 2026.

P. Jain Institute of Management & Research (SPJIMR), established in 1981 in Mumbai, is a leading management institute, recognised by Financial Times Global Rankings 2024 as India’s #1 business school, by Business Today as one of the country’s top five business schools, and by the Positive Impact Rating (PIR), a Swiss Association, as a ‘pioneering’ school with the highest ‘Level 5’ rating for its societal impact and sustainability achievements. A constituent of Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan, India’s visionary educational trust established in 1938, SPJIMR offers a broad portfolio of management programmes to individual participants and organisations. Accredited by the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB), Association of MBAs (AMBA) (UK), and EFMD Quality Improvement System (EQUIS), SPJIMR is part of an elite group of institutions globally to achieve the prestigious ‘Triple Crown’ of accreditations, placing it among the top 1% of global business schools. It is a category-I management institute in India under AICTE. Our mission We aim to influence managerial practice and promote value-based growth of our students and alumni, organisations and their leaders, and society at large. We do so by ‘advancing wise innovation’ at scale through teaching, thought leadership, and industry and community engagement. Our vision We aspire to be recognised globally as an innovative and socially-conscious management school. Our values Our values guide each of us at SPJIMR to act with courage and heart, and live our mission. We are/aspire to be: Socially-sensitive Using Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) as our call to action, we seek to serve all sections of society, including those on the margins Open-minded We value diversity and inclusion, and make space for a range of ideas, including those that challenge us Committed to individual and team excellence We pursue our individual goals with passion while supporting and delighting in our colleagues’ successes Action-oriented We innovate and act decisively on our intent, knowing that perfect is the enemy of good #Advancing WiseInnovation Our pursuit at SPJIMR centres on a very specific type of innovation, which we refer to as ‘wise innovation’. We define ‘wise innovation’ – as purposeful innovation done for the right reasons in the right way. This concept goes beyond mere novelty; it requires a nuanced understanding of innovation’s broader impact and implications. Know more. SPJIMR’s Societal Impact Since its inception, SPJIMR has pioneered several unique initiatives that have established its reputation as a world leader in creating positive societal impact. These initiatives deeply integrate the SPJIMR community of participants, faculty, and professional staff with our local K-Ward community, with grassroots NGOs across the Indian subcontinent, and the emerging community of entrepreneurs dedicated to creating positive societal impact. Know more Our commitment to sustainability SPJIMR SDG Dashboard SPJIMR Mobile SDG Dashboard SPJIMR is committed to achieving seven focused Sustainable Development Goals through its teaching, research, and community engagement. The institute aspires to become a Net Zero campus by 2030, working on initiatives in areas such as green energy, rainwater harvesting, and sustainable waste management. Explore our newsletter and discover the exciting initiatives we’ve been working on. Ecosphere 2025 | Issue 1 Ecosphere 2025 | Issue 2 Click to discover how our research impacts the seven SDGs we prioritise: SPJIMR is committed to achieving a set of seven focused Sustainable Development Goals through its teaching, research and community engagements. Click below to follow SPJIMR’s contributions to the UN SDGs. SPJIMR SDG Dashboard SPJIMR Mobile SDG Dashboard GOAL 4 Quality Education GOAL 4 Quality Education Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all GOAL 8 Decent Work and Economic Growth GOAL 8 Decent Work and Economic Growth Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all GOAL 9 Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure GOAL 9 Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialisation and foster innovation GOAL 10 Reduced Inequality GOAL 10 Reduced Inequality Reduce inequality within and among countries GOAL 12 Responsible Consumption and Production GOAL 12 Responsible Consumption and Production Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns GOAL 16 Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions GOAL 16 Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions Promote peaceful and inclusive societies for sustainable development, provide access to justice for all and build effective, accountable and inclusive institutions at all levels GOAL 17 Partnerships for the Goals GOAL 17 Partnerships for the Goals Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the Global Partnership for Sustainable Development Why SPJIMR? Reputation Global dimension Alumni power Placement outcomes Immersive experiences Practice focus Mumbai location Societal impact SPJIMR is consistently in the top 10 of Indian B-school rankings , and is establishing a global reputation as a school dedicated to fostering responsible innovation that benefits society. SPJIMR is known across the student community for its teaching excellence and across the industry for the quality of its graduates. 100% of participants in SPJIMR’s full-time programmes attend a short-term international immersion programme , travelling to and studying at top academic institutions globally. Additionally, several participants take advantage of a longer but optional international exchange programme with partner universities in the USA, Europe and Asia. Participants graduate from SPJIMR with the global fluency that today’s managers need. Read more. Our 18,000+ alumni hold high-impact leadership positions across the globe in large corporations, family-managed businesses, entrepreneurial start-ups, and non-profit organisations. SPJIMR’s alumni network is uniquely vested in the success of their fellow alumni and the institute. The network mentors new participants, collaborates with faculty, opens up opportunities for continued career growth to its members, and creates and sustains lifelong personal and business relationships. Full-time students enjoy the support of the country’s best career services office, with a consistent placement record of 100%, even during the pandemic, and compensation that ranks amongst the country’s highest for new B-school graduates. These results reflect industry’s perception of SPJIMR graduates as innovative and grounded team players who can hit the ground running. Read more . SPJIMR was the first management school in India to introduce ‘ non-classroom learning ’ experiences in its pedagogy more than twenty years ago, and constant innovation has kept it at the forefront. Its participants immerse themselves in a carefully curated set of experiences that are designed to put them outside their comfort zone. Collectively, these experiences accelerate their leadership development, teaching them to understand, reflect, and act in unfamiliar situations. SPJIMR’s mission to influence practice permeates everything it does in co-creating curriculum with the industry and bridging the worlds of theory and practice. The faculty is a unique mix of accomplished scholars, richly experienced industry and non-profit practitioners, and hybrid scholar-practitioners. A quest for relevance guides their research. SPJIMR’s four Centres of Practice (CoP) focus on learning about and influencing important communities. As a result, SPJIMR participants are more practice-ready upon graduation than their external peers. Mumbai is one of the world’s most vibrant cities, blending a dynamic commercial culture with a global and cosmopolitan outlook. Our strong ties with national and international businesses in Mumbai add currency, relevance, and impact to our teaching and thought leadership and produce outstanding placement results. P articipants are exposed to leading practitioners in the classroom while they enjoy the excitement and cultural flair of Mumbai outside the classroom. SPJIMR’s societal impact initiatives have been recognised globally. The Positive Impact Ratings (PIR) has recognised SPJIMR as a ‘pioneering school’ for social impact and sustainability achievements every year since 2021. Read more.
